input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: Article X(b) imposes a one-way non-solicit on us (Licensee) only, running for three years after expiration or termination and covering every employee of Licensor and all of its Affiliates. That exceeds our walk-away limits (no restriction beyond 24 months and none covering all Vendor personnel). The clause does already contain an acceptable general-advertising / unsolicited-inquiry carve-out and no no-hire language, so consistent with the redline guidance we narrowed to the fallback with minimal edits: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in performance, and 12 months from the end of that involvement.

ops.oldText: During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
ops.newText: During the Term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after the last date on which an individual was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement, neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party who was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement to leave his or her employment with such other party.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the non-solicit mutual and narrowed it to personnel directly involved in the performance of this Agreement for twelve (12) months after their involvement ends, keeping the existing general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-out. Our playbook does not accept a one-way, three-year restriction covering all Licensor and Affiliate employees.
proposal.summary: Mutualize non-solicit; limit to involved personnel and 12 months.
